change_summary: Keep owner discovery on bounded read tools, distinguish carried continuations from search-selected structural owners, use one semantic Question per authorized effect, and preserve one complete Resource Front across Reply, Code Interpreter, and source-only Sub-agent readers.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill keeps owner discovery on direct reads, requires missing carried-Project context without rereading search-selected structural containers, prevents answer-only preview Questions before writes, and carries exact positive and negative owner handles into one semantic effect.

server_contract.note: The server advertises release 1.7.85 and contract 2026-09-27.2 with the same one-Question effect, complete-owner-receipt, typed source, Resource Front, direct-write, Work Model, and economics boundaries as Skill and CLI.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin versions advance together for durable learning, host clarification, and cross-host semantic materialization.

workspace_cli.note: The CLI supports typed Host Markdown while keeping owner discovery on search/docs reads, prohibiting answer-only preview calls, and carrying constrained-owner handles into one allow-actions effect.

help_center.note: Public Help explains the one semantic Question rule, complete-owner evidence, carried-versus-search-selected owner reads, and exact positive and negative owner handoff.

package_setup.note: The session hook reports release 1.7.85 and contract 2026-09-27.2 and exposes the owner-read, one-Question and cross-host materialization boundaries before deferred Skill loading.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records the owner-reader versus semantic-effect boundary, 2 KiB MCP spine, corrected receipt oracle, separate outcome/economics/Host-conformance ledgers, linked fresh-Host recall evidence, and remaining source-byte/discovery instability.

external_marketplaces.note: Publishing release 1.7.85 and deployed-package discovery remain separate release-owned gates; fresh local Codex and Claude Host acceptance is recorded in the Harness reports.

public_release_assets.note: The canonical exporter will regenerate both immutable archives from synchronized 1.7.85 Skill, references, manifests, and hook source.

release_evidence.note: Schema, MCP/CLI/Skill parity, Resource Front composition, realistic receipt identity, exact-effect grading, linked fresh-Host recall and package export cover the corrected route. A reachable 20/20 run and a later 14/20 strict, 18/20 outcome repeat remain separate evidence; Skill discovery and exact Host-source binding are still open.
